**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Section 11 (Term/Termination/Effect of Termination) and Section 12 (Source Code Escrow) were read in full; targeted searches for transition, assistance, wind-down, migration, export, deletion and "data" returned no exit provisions. The escrow licence in 12.3 triggers only on the limited Release Conditions in 12.2, not on expiry or termination, and 11.3 addresses only mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information — no assistance period and no data export timetable.
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback in a hosting agreement (no data return, no assistance), so an insert is warranted rather than a rewrite of neighbouring text.
- **Cure:** One new Section 11.4 carrying exactly the three fallback elements — obligations triggered on any expiration or termination, at least 90 days of transition assistance on request, and export/delivery of all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers within 30 days. Preferred-only extras (then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) were deliberately omitted, and the "at then-current rates" cost element was not volunteered.
